exposure: cervical ripening with slow-release prostaglandin pessary
cervical ripening with vaginal prostaglandin gel
cohort: 178 nulliparous women with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation and an unfavorable cervix requiring labor induction for prolonged pregnancy
finding: The rate of failed induction of labor did not differ between slow-release prostaglandin pessary and vaginal prostaglandin gel for cervical ripening.
